column1: # Provenance of the YANG modules nl6 serves through get-schema (RFC 6022).
# Every IETF/IANA module is fetched unmodified from YangModels/yang at the commit
# the gNMI catalogue already pins (Makefile CISCO_YANG_COMMIT). Their licence is
# the IETF Trust Simplified BSD licence stated inside each file.
# RFC 5277 defines its schema in XSD, not YANG; notifications and
# nc-notifications are CESNET's YANG renderings of it, as Netopeer2 serves them,
# taken unmodified from CESNET/netopeer2 at a pinned commit (BSD-3-Clause,
